en.help.scan.lay_scan: Lays the scan on a flat face of its hull and shows the candidate faces. Use it first, so measuring starts from the face the part stands on.
en.help.scan.recognise: Measures the laid scan and builds the part from it, then compares that body with the part's own. Use it after Lay Scan.
en.help.scan.intend: Records what the model is for: reproduce, repair or modify. Pick the broken place on the scan for Repair.
en.help.scan.repair: Marks the picked place on the scan as broken and rebuilds it from the mirror or a neighbouring feature. Use it on a torn or worn spot.
en.help.scan.feature: Tells the build the picked place is a feature of the chosen kind. On a piece of a new part, Rib or Clip redraws it as that kind. Use it where the scan was read wrong.
en.help.scan.modify: Sets a parameter of the picked place to the value typed. Use it to change a wall, hole or rib on purpose.
en.help.scan.ignore: Marks the picked place as a hole in the scan, not in the part. The build fills it as the part around it.
en.help.scan.keep: Marks the picked place as made that way on purpose. The build keeps it as measured.
en.help.scan.accept: Keeps the picked body feature in the next build, or the picked piece of a new part as drawn. Use it on what is right.
en.help.scan.reject: Leaves the picked body feature out of the next build, or removes the picked piece of a new part for good. Use it on what the part does not have.
en.help.scan.measured: Drops the decision on the picked feature or piece and goes back to what the scan measures. Use it to undo Accept, Reject or Stronger.
en.help.scan.section: Sketches the scan's section through the picked point, square to the chosen axis, as lines and arcs. Dimension it and extrude or revolve to trace the part.
en.help.scan.panel: Draws the part's face panel from its scan: the outline from above with its windows, the side profile with its bends, the thickness. Where the scan's face is twisted, the panel follows it. Pressing it again replaces the panel, unless you accepted it.
en.help.scan.stands: Draws what stands on the panel, after Panel: the wall along the edge, the ribs, and each clip or post traced from the scan's sections, hook included, each a body coloured by state: amber ones to check first. Pressing it again replaces them, except pieces you accepted; rejected ones stay out.
en.help.scan.round: Rounds the selected edges with the radius the scan has there. Edges sharp on the scan are left as they are; an edge onto a bend the radius does not fit is named in the reply.
en.help.scan.check: Colours the scan and the body within and beyond the tolerance, both ways. Turn on live to check after every change.
en.help.scan.build: Builds the body again from the decisions and the parameters changed in the design. On a new part, drafts the scan as a body in 1 mm layers: a sketch of the scan's section outline and an extrude per layer, with no design intent.
en.help.scan.print: Lays the body on the picked face, or the best one, and opens it in the slicer.
en.help.scan.load_test: Holds the first picked face, loads the second with the force and shows the stress and the safety. The solver runs on the server.
en.help.scan.animate: Plays the last Load Test bend from no load to the force and back, then leaves the full bend shown.
en.help.scan.stronger: Grows the feature at the worst place until the safety reaches the threshold, then builds it. As Measured on that feature takes it back.
